```yaml
name: Draft Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      new_version:
        description: "New version number (e.g., 7.7.1). If not provided, auto-determined via release-dry-run."
        required: false
        type: string
      model:
        description: "Model abbreviation (codex, glm, kimi) to determine the model for the release."
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  draft-release:
    if: >
      github.actor == 'dyoshikawa' ||
      github.actor == 'cm-dyoshikawa'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@8e8c483db84b4bee98b60c0593521ed34d9990e8 # v6.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup mise
        uses: jdx/mise-action@6d1e696aa24c1aa1bcc1adea0212707c71ab78a8 # v3.6.1
        with:
          experimental: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Determine model
        id: select-model
        uses: ./.github/actions/select-opencode-model
        with:
          input-text: ${{ github.event.inputs.model }}

      - name: Auto-determine version if not provided
        id: version
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" ]; then
            echo "version=${{ github.event.inputs.new_version }}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            # Run release-dry-run to determine next version
            VERSION=$(pnpm run release-dry-run | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 | sed 's/^v//')
            if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
              echo "Failed to auto-determine version"
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Create release branch and PR
        id: create-pr
        run: |
          BRANCH_NAME="release/v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          git checkout -b "$BRANCH_NAME"
          
          # Commit version bump
          echo "Bumping version to ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" > version-bump.txt
          git add version-bump.txt
          git commit -m "chore: bump version to v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          
          # Push branch
          git push origin "$BRANCH_NAME"
          
          # Create PR
          gh pr create \
            --title "Release v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}" \
            --body "Release PR for v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}. This PR will be merged to trigger the publishing process." \
            --head "$BRANCH_NAME" \
            --base main
          
          echo "branch_name=$BRANCH_NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Create draft release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          release_name: Release v${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
```
